fpr_explanation: The 12.5% False Positive Rate (FPR = FP / (FP + TN) = 1 / (1 + 7) = 1/8) arises because the benchmark includes 8 negative/neutral control cases and exactly 1 false alert fired. Precision remains high at 95.2% (20/21) across all emitted alerts.

incorrect_cases.speaker: AGENT
incorrect_cases.text: Thank you for providing that. Let me look up our standard commercial tiers.
incorrect_cases.root_cause_analysis: The heuristic topic-shift classifier detected the lexical token 'tier' from 'commercial tiers' and categorized it as a transition from greeting to qualification/pricing. In production, this can be refined by conditioning topic shifts on multi-token phrases or customer utterances rather than agent acknowledgments.
